idee_recherchee.texte: Phantom limb pain happens when the brain keeps sending signals to a missing arm or leg, so the person still feels pain in a body part that no longer exists.

titre_video: Insane Pain Facts, From Phantom Limbs to Brain Freeze
titre: The brain itself feels no pain
resume: Facts 35 and 34: the brain does not feel pain, nerves send signals to it, and the brain has no nerves inside it, so a surgeon could cut it with a scalpel and the patient would feel nothing.
texte: 35. [music] The brain doesn't actually feel pain. It's the nerves that send the signals back to the brain so the brain can react. Number 34. But also the [music] brain itself doesn't have nerves. It's surrounded by nerves, but there are none inside it. That's why a surgeon could wield a scalpel in there and the patient wouldn't feel any pain at all. Number
